# CodePipelineProcessUpdatedSummary

What the `code-pipeline-process-updated` event carries: a short summary of a code pipeline run that changed. Fetch the run for its steps, output and detail.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | The run's id. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The run's tenant. |
| `status` | [`CodePipelineProcessStatus`](code-pipeline-process-status.md) | The run's status. |
| `failureReason` | `string \| null` | What kind of failure it was, when Maitento could tell: `Auth`, `RateLimit`, `Quota`, `Transient`, `Terminal`, `EndpointModelNotFound` or `Endpoint`. Null means "not classified", not "did not fail": read `status` for that. |
| `failureDetails` | `string \| null` | What went wrong, when the run failed. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When the run last changed, in UTC. |
| `dateEnded` | `datetime \| null` | When the run ended, in UTC; null while it is live. |
| `toolUseCount` | `integer` | How many tool calls the run's agents have made so far, so you can tell new ones arrived without fetching them. |
| `contextEntryCount` | `integer` | How many transcript entries (the agents' text and thinking) the run has so far. |
| `awaitingHumanInput` | `boolean` | Whether the run has asked a question that is still unanswered. A run can ask while another step keeps working, so this can be true whatever the `status`. |
| `pipelineId` | `uuid \| null` | The id of the code pipeline the run was started from. |
| `pipelineVersion` | `integer \| null` | The version of the code pipeline the run was started from. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime \| null` | When the run was created, in UTC. |
| `dateStarted` | `datetime \| null` | When the run started, in UTC. |
| `userCreatedById` | `uuid \| null` | The id of the user who started the run. |
| `parentProcessId` | `uuid \| null` | The id of the run that started this one, such as an app run; null for a run started directly. |
| `parentProcessType` | [`ProcessType`](process-type.md)`\| null` | The kind of run `parentProcessId` is. |
| `rootProcessId` | `uuid \| null` | The id of the run at the top of this run's tree. |
